== TF History ==
Started playing in 1999 on Mplayer with a 56K modem.  Moved on shortly thereafter to QuakeWorld where he was active until 2003-2004, when he took a hiatus to concentrate on work and family life.  Now sporadically plays on Phoenixlabs Custom TF and Co-op servers.

He currently resides in Minnesota, with his wife and 2 year old son, who will be training to follow in his father's footsteps.
